versions.shortDescription: Fetch a UCI dataset by id via ucimlrepo and export a single combined CSV (features + targets).
versions.longDescription:
# UciFetchToCsv

UciFetchToCsv is a small database adopter tool that fetches a dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository via ucimlrepo (by numeric dataset ID) and exports it as a single combined CSV containing features + targets.

## What this tool does
- Fetches a UCI dataset by ID
Uses ucimlrepo.fetch_ucirepo(id=dataset_id) to retrieve the dataset payload and metadata.
- Normalizes UCI payloads into tables
Converts pandas.Series to a one-column DataFrame and passes through DataFrame objects unchanged.
- Builds one consolidated tabular dataset
- Reads ds.data.features as the feature matrix (X)
- Reads ds.data.targets as the target(s) (y)
- Concatenates horizontally (column-wise) into one table:
If feature and target columns overlap in name, target columns are renamed with the prefix:_

## Configuration

Hyperparameters
- dataset_id (INTEGER, default: 17)
Numeric UCI dataset identifier used by ucimlrepo to fetch the dataset (e.g., 17 = Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic).

There are no inputs for this tool.

## Outputs
- dataset (CSV)
A single CSV file containing the merged dataset (features + targets).
- report (TEXT)
A small human-readable summary including dataset id/name and output shape.

## Notes / Assumptions
- If a dataset provides only features or only targets, the tool exports whichever exists.
- If a dataset provides neither features nor targets, the tool raises an error.
- The tool is designed specifically for producing one flat table suitable for downstream processing and tooling that expects CSV.
